newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico and Guatemala sign electricity pact.
newsitem.headline: Mexico and Guatemala sign electricity pact.

text.p: Mexican and Guatemalan government officials signed an agreement Thursday to share electric systems and common border energy supplies, Mexico's Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) said.
The bilateral accord connects the two nations' electricity systems and arranges mutual support in case of emergencies.

"The accord opens the possibility of maintaining security in the two systems, in Guatemala and in Mexico ..., in a way that will support one another in questions of emergency and maximum demand," CFE director general Rogelio Gasca Neri said in a statement.
Gasca Neri said the accord will also bring Mexico closer to exporting energy and fulfilling its commitment to supply energy to 41 Guatemalan communities.
